title: Luke 19:45-48
subtitle: Friday of the 33rd Week in Ordinary Time · Rev 10:8-11; Lk 19:45-48
text: Jesus drove the sellers out of the temple, then stayed every day to teach there. He clears room so he can speak. What crowds your prayer? Clear one thing out today, and listen.
imageAlt: El Greco painting of Christ raising a whip to drive merchants and money changers out of the temple, figures recoiling on either side under a classical archway
credit: El Greco, Christ Driving the Money Changers from the Temple, c. 1570, Minneapolis Institute of Art. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
